Research 18.05.2026 Central London Office Market Update Q1 2026
Total take-up reached 2.5m sq ft
The City recorded a measured opening to the year, with take-up totalling 1.0m sq ft
West End experienced a stronger start to the year, with take-up rising to 0.8m sq ft
overall Central London vacancy rate reduced to 8.4%
The West End retained the lowest vacancy profile across Central London, declining further to 6.8% in Q1 2026
The City followed a similar trajectory, with vacancy reducing to 9.8%
Media & Tech emerged as the most active occupier group during Q1 2026, accounting for 23.5% of total take-up
The Services sector ranked second with a 19.8% share of activity
Banking & Finance represented 17.0% of quarterly take-up
Grade A space accounting for 78.0% of all take-up during Q1 2026
Grade B stock continues to dominate overall availability, accounting for 73% of total supply across Central London
